name: toggle
behavior: APG button pattern with aria-pressed (Enter and Space toggle the pressed state; the accessible name stays the same in both states — the state is carried by aria-pressed, never by relabelling; the control is a single tab stop. A toggle placed in a group takes radio/checkbox semantics instead and roving focus — that is toggle-group, a different anatomy.)

parts.statesNote: state:selected (aria-pressed=true) takes the interaction-selected / on-interaction-selected pair

parts.note: icon role is content-dependent (bold, mute, pin…); success is only the schema's placeholder — an icon-only toggle still needs an aria-label

anatomyNotes: Parts are anatomy/button.json's minus the loading indicator and the trailing icon — a toggle is a button that remembers. What it adds is the selected state as a first-class, persistent state rather than a transient one. Axis mapping: shadcn's variant default (transparent) → prominence:ghost and outline → prominence:outline; Salt's appearance solid → prominence:solid and bordered → prominence:outline, so all three cells are attested. Salt's `sentiment` (emphasis axis) and `readOnly` state are Salt-only and are therefore NOT in this anatomy — a theme wanting them declares a fallback (variants.md §Fallback ladder). Salt's size comes from density, so the size axis is frozen there, as for every other control.
